targets.description: List of target directories or files to scan for duplicates.

types.description: Comma-separated list of lint types (e.g., 'defaults', 'df,dd', 'all -df'). See man page for groups and types.

outputs.description: List of output specs in format 'format:destination'. e.g., 'sh:/path/to/script.sh', 'json:stdout'.

configs.description: List of format configs in format 'format:option=value'. e.g., 'sh:handler=remove'.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm to use. Examples: blake2b, sha256, md5, paranoid.

verbose.description: If true, uses -VVV (loud). If false, uses -V (quiet).

progress.description: If true, enables progress bar (-g). If false, disables it (-G).

hardlink_policy.description: Hardlink handling: '--hardlinked', '--keep-hardlinked', or '--no-hardlinked'. Empty for default.

symlink_policy.description: Symlink handling: '-f' (follow), '-F' (no-follow), or '-@' (see-symlinks). Empty for default (-@).

no_cross_dev.description: If true, uses -x (stay on same device). If false, uses -X (allow cross-devices).

hidden_policy.description: Hidden file handling: '-r' (include hidden), '-R' (no hidden), or '--partial-hidden'. Empty for default (-R).

size_range.description: Size range filter: 'min-max' or single size. e.g., '100KB', '0-2M'.

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth. e.g., '1' for non-recursive, '2' for one level deep. 'INF' for infinite.

threads.description: Number of threads to use. e.g., 16.

mem_limit.description: Memory limit for hashing. e.g., '512M', '1G'. Empty for no limit.

keep_tagged.description: If true, uses -k (--keep-all-tagged). If false, uses -K (--keep-all-untagged) if other match flags are set.

must_match_tagged.description: If true, uses -m (--must-match-tagged). If false, uses -M (--must-match-untagged) if keep flags are set.

rank_by.description: Ranking criteria string. e.g., 'pOma', 'm'. See man page for criteria letters.

sort_by.description: Sorting criteria for output groups. e.g., 's', 'a'. Empty for default (none).

mtime_window.description: Mtime window in seconds for duplicate grouping. e.g., 0, 1, -1.

use_xattr.description: If true, uses -C (--xattr) for caching checksums in extended attributes.

clamp_low.description: Clamp low parameter. e.g., '10%', '100B'. Empty for default (0).

clamp_top.description: Clamp top parameter. e.g., '50%', '1G'. Empty for default (1.0).

no_fiemap.description: If true, uses --without-fiemap. If false, uses --with-fiemap.
